# FreePythonCompiler

> Free, instant online Python & web code compiler and interactive IDE running 100% in your browser via WebAssembly (Pyodide) with zero installation, zero server latency, and full privacy.

FreePythonCompiler is a modern web-based developer playground and educational platform designed for instant code execution without backend dependencies or account paywalls.

## Core Capabilities & Architecture

- **Online Python 3.12 Compiler**: Full standard library support powered by Pyodide compiled to WebAssembly (WASM). Executes natively on client hardware via modern Web Workers for zero-latency execution and high privacy.
- **Web Development Playground (HTML / CSS / JavaScript)**: Real-time code execution with live sandboxed iframe preview, multi-tab layout, and console integration.
- **VS Code Monaco Editor**: Integrated Microsoft Monaco Editor featuring full syntax highlighting, intelligent auto-completion, bracket matching, formatting, and custom dark/light themes.
- **Thonny Online Alternative**: Lightweight, beginner-oriented interface for schools, coding clubs, and Chromebooks without administrator privileges.
- **AI-Ready In-Browser IDE**: Contextual IntelliSense, instant syntax linting, and 100% code privacy (code never leaves the user's browser).
- **Zero Server Delay**: Code executes locally in the user's browser sandbox. No server queues, no rate limits, and no risk of remote code leaks.
- **100% Free & Accessible**: No login, subscription, or API keys required. Accessible to students, educators, and professional developers globally.
